title: Hero, text beside an image
description: A label, a large headline, an introduction and two buttons beside a tall image. The image goes below the text on small screens.

eyebrow.label: Label
eyebrow.description: A few words above the heading: what the section is about.

title.label: Headline
title.description: The promise of the site in one line: what visitors get, not the business name.

body.label: Introduction
body.description: Who it is for and what to do next, in one or two sentences.

actions.label: Buttons
actions.description: The main action first (call, book, order, ask for a quote), then a secondary one.

image.label: Image
image.subject: the business at its best: its place, its work or its products
image.description: A tall picture that shows what the business does.
